title: Efficacy and Safety Dose Titration Study of Botulinum Toxin Type A to Treat Spasticity in the Leg and Arm
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether injections with increasing doses (up to 800 units) of Botulinum toxin type A into muscles of the leg and/or arm are safe and effective in treating patients with spasticity on one body side due to cerebral causes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Upper and lower limb spasticity of the same body side due to cerebral causes
* Time since event leading to spasticity in the target body side greater than 12 weeks
* Need for 800 units Botulinum toxin type A

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body weight below 50kg
* Fixed contractures of the target joint
* Generalized disorders of muscle activity like Myasthenia gravis that preclude use of Botulinum toxin type A
* Infection at the injection site
condition: Spasticity of the Upper and Lower Limb Due to Cerebral Causes
